enable_memcached.description: Enable or disable the memcached service ('yes' or 'no').

memory_mb.description: Amount of RAM (in MB) to allocate for the cache.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

tcp_port.description: TCP port to listen on for connections.

udp_port.description: UDP port to listen on (set to 0 to disable UDP).

listen_ip.description: IP address(es) to bind to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces, or comma-separated list).

daemonize.description: Run memcached as a background daemon (recommended for production).

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the memcached process.

run_as_user.description: System user account to run memcached under (when started as root).

max_item_size_mb.description: Maximum size of a single cache item (in MB). Range: 1KB to 128MB.

slab_growth_factor.description: Growth factor between slabs (higher = fewer slabs, larger gap between sizes).

slab_page_size_mb.description: Size of each slab page (in MB). Affects internal memory fragmentation.

disable_locking.description: Disable thread locking (unsafe unless using event-based I/O).

storage_dirs.description: List of custom storage directories (advanced use). Each entry defines a slab page size.

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass to memcached (e.g., ['-k', '-vv', '-o', 'hash_algorithm=xxhash64']).
